status: Design proposal, not an implemented network service

request_example.instruction: Respond to Sol without revealing the launch code.

context_builder_responsibilities: Select the speaker's profile, private memories, relevant established facts, and visible recent dialogue.
Filter recipient visibility before building the model prompt; other characters' private state is excluded.
Apply a token budget with space reserved for the reply. Report omitted event IDs and summary versions.
Keep stable context before changing turn instructions to enable prompt-prefix reuse.
Retain the complete event log outside model context; summaries are derived views, not replacements for the log.

model_output_example.text: Check the hinge. We still have five minutes.

application_envelope_example.text: Check the hinge. We still have five minutes.

output_gateway_responsibilities: For dialogue, keep application-owned identity and routing outside generated text; optionally wrap plain text without asking the model to generate metadata.
When structured content is required, parse strictly and reject duplicate keys, wrong types, unknown fields, and invalid speaker IDs.
Validate constraints and finish_reason before broadcasting or committing state; a length-truncated answer is not treated as complete.
Return explicit violations or attempt one bounded correction. Preserve the original output and charge correction tokens/time separately.
Deduplicate retries by request_id and reject stale expected_state_version values.
The application assigns message IDs, recipients, and state versions. Model text cannot authorize routing or state changes.
Stream provisional text only to the requesting UI; publish a committed character event after final validation.
open_choices: First consumer: interactive chat, script editor, or an external app/game.
Transport and durable state store for persistent character workers.
Character memory summarizer, retrieval policy, and context size per role.
